question: International Day of Non-violence is marked on which of the following freedom fighter’s birth anniversary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• International Day of Non-Violence is observed on **October 2nd** each year.
 
• This day marks the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**, a prominent leader in India's struggle for independence.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi is renowned for his philosophy of **non-violence (Ahimsa)** and his role in leading peaceful protests.
 
• The day was established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2007 to promote the principle of non-violence through education and public awareness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**

 
 
• Full name: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi
 
• Born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar, India
 
• Known as the "Father of the Nation" in India
 
• Led the Indian independence movement against British colonial rule
 
• Advocated for civil rights and freedom through non-violent civil disobedience
 
• His key movements include the Salt March and Quit India Movement
 
 
 
• **Non-Violence (Ahimsa)**
 
 
• Ahimsa is a Sanskrit term meaning "non-injury" or "non-violence"
 
• It is a fundamental principle in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism
 
• Gandhi applied the concept of Ahimsa as a tool for social and political change
 
• He believed that non-violence is the most powerful weapon to fight oppression and injustice
 
 
 
• **United Nations General Assembly**
 
 
• One of the six principal organs of the United Nations
 
• Composed of all 193 Member States of the United Nations
 
• Provides a unique forum for multilateral discussion of international issues
 
• Responsible for establishing the International Day of Non-Violence in 2007
